scope.user: Owner creating multiple independent responsive web products
scope.promised_outcome: Reuse common infrastructure and start a new product without rewriting authentication, ownership and recurring billing
excluded_capabilities: Real charges or fabricated account sessions in preview

design_decision.chosen_interaction_model: Visible three-destination navigation, desktop project cards and compact phone rows, focused dialogs, and clear recovery screens
design_decision.reason: Makes the infrastructure inspectable and provides a working example. Future applications choose layouts for their own tasks.
design_decision.main_remaining_tradeoff: Generic sample entities and plan descriptions require replacement for a real idea.

evidence: Create a named project through a labeled, validated form and inspect it
Reload preserves browser-stored projects; closing an unfinished create dialog preserves its draft
Failed storage retains input and explains that nothing was saved; empty collection has a clear action; deletion requires confirmation

checks.phone_and_desktop: 40 Playwright checks passed on production-compiled preview across desktop Chrome/Firefox and phone Chrome/WebKit emulation, including 320px reflow, 200% text, long content, missing-page recovery and short viewports
checks.accessibility: Input labels and actual mounted description/error references, visible success states, keyboard dismissal/return/containment, form scrolling, primary touch targets and selected axe A/AA rules checked. No physical-device or assistive-technology session conducted.
checks.visual_review: Desktop and phone workspace/billing screenshots reviewed; semantic light/dark tokens and touch controls used
checks.persistence: Preview browser persistence checked; server ownership/RLS checked in PGlite; real Supabase persistence remains unverified
checks.billing: SDK signature, event transaction/order/retry, expiry and ownership tests pass; no merchant sandbox lifecycle performed
checks.performance: Production compilation passes; no Core Web Vitals lab or field measurements

observed_problems_and_fixes: Shared upstream form control targeted a wrapper instead of the actual input; compatibility wrapper now wires labels, descriptions and errors to the input
Programmatically opened dialogs lacked a return-focus target; explicit targets and a deletion fallback were added
Authentication entrance animation and fixed screen height complicated stable reading and small-screen layout; replaced with a stable layout that grows with content
Automated scans captured a button while leaving its loading state and a dialog during entrance; tests now wait for interactive, fully visible states
Phone layout stacked large desktop cards; replaced with compact rows preserving names, descriptions, dates and detail access
Removed repeated page eyebrows and global preview/billing notices; compact desktop navigation preserves all destinations
Create/delete status was available only to assistive technology; now also visible
200% text overflowed navigation and long control labels; wrapped navigation, labels and buttons with stable edge padding
Optional form descriptions created dangling ARIA references; registered mounted descriptions and errors in the shared wrapper
Inherited error pages had oversized headings, a mislabeled reset button and a nonexistent contact destination; replaced with clear retry/workspace recovery
Root-error page relied on missing providers and styles; replaced with independent native recovery controls
Past-due copy now distinguishes verified grace access from expired access
external_integrations_unverified: Supabase services and concurrent real connections
